description: The Doctor never auto-applies fixes without explicit user confirmation. All fix applications require a prior user action.
property: For any AutoFix application, the system SHALL NOT modify configuration without prior user confirmation. The fix record SHALL be persisted with previous values for rollback.

invariants.description: No fix is applied without an explicit apply_fix or apply_fix_batch IPC call from the UI
Every applied fix must have a corresponding FixRecord with previous values stored
For reversible fixes, the previous values must be sufficient to restore the original state
